items.reason: Every job row renders a colored progress bar plus a numeric percentage (e.g. 38%, 47%, 95%) driven by the API's job progress field, updating as jobs run.
Queued/running jobs expose a Cancel button; clicking it showed a disabled 'Cancelling…' state, issued one cancelJob call, and the job settled to failed with details 'Cancelled by admin'.

Each failed row shows its specific error ('Worker ran out of memory at 1.8 GB', 'Upstream timeout after 30s') in the Details cell directly beside its Retry button, and a failed retry action at fail=1 raised a specific toast 'Failed to retry: Network error — try again'.
After a retry failed on the network, the Retry button re-enabled and a second click issued another retryJob call without any page reload.
